# Sistema de Pedidos para Restaurante

Sistema completo de pedidos para restaurante, pronto para uso em computadores e celulares. Não necessita de serviços externos e armazena todos os dados de forma permanente no próprio servidor.

---

## 🚀 Como instalar e rodar (Passo a Passo)

Você só precisa ter o **Python** instalado no seu computador (se não tiver, baixe a versão mais recente em [python.org](https://www.python.org)).

### 1. Abra o Terminal ou Prompt de Comando
Navegue até a pasta onde descompactou os arquivos do projeto:
```bash
cd caminho/para/a/pasta
```

### 2. Instale os componentes necessários
Execute o comando:
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### 3. Inicie o sistema
Execute o comando:
```bash
python app.py
```

### 4. Acesse no navegador
Abra seu navegador de internet e entre no endereço:
```
http://localhost:5000
```

Para acessar pelo **celular ou outro computador na mesma rede Wi-Fi**, basta abrir o navegador do celular e digitar o IP do computador onde o sistema está rodando (exemplo: `http://192.168.1.100:5000`). O próprio terminal mostra o endereço de rede ao iniciar.

---

## 👥 Contas de Acesso

O sistema já vem inicializado com um cardápio de exemplo e a conta do gerente:

- **Gerente (Administrador):**
  - **E-mail:** `gerente@restaurante.com`
  - **Senha:** `admin123`
  - *Funções:* Ver todos os pedidos em tempo real, mudar o status dos pedidos (Recebido, Em Preparo, Saiu para Entrega, Entregue, Cancelado), adicionar, editar, pausar e remover pratos do cardápio.

- **Clientes:**
  - Qualquer pessoa pode clicar em **"Criar Conta"** na tela inicial, cadastrar seu nome, telefone e endereço.
  - *Funções:* Navegar pelo cardápio, adicionar itens ao carrinho com observações, fechar pedidos e acompanhar o andamento em tempo real.

---

## 💾 Onde ficam salvos os dados?

Todos os dados (usuários, cardápio, fotos e histórico de pedidos) são gravados no arquivo de banco de dados `restaurante.db`, criado automaticamente na mesma pasta. Mesmo se o computador for desligado, nada é perdido.

import os
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template, session
from werkzeug.security import generate_password_hash, check_password_hash

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SECRET_KEY'] = os.environ.get('SECRET_KEY', 'restaurante-chave-secreta-segura-2025')
DB_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'restaurante.db')

def get_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn

def init_db():
    conn = get_db()
    cursor = conn.cursor()

    cursor.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cliente',
            phone TEXT,
            address TEXT,
            created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    ''')

    cursor.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS categories (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL
        )
    ''')

    cursor.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dishes (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            category_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT,
            price REAL NOT NULL,
            image_url TEXT,
            is_available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
        )
    ''')

    cursor.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            customer_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            customer_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
            delivery_address TEXT NOT NULL,
            payment_method TEXT NOT NULL,
            notes TEXT,
            total_price REAL NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'recebido',
            created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
        )
    ''')

    cursor.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS order_items (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            order_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            dish_id INTEGER,
            dish_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            unit_price REAL NOT NULL,
            quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
            subtotal REAL NOT NULL,
            notes TEXT,
            FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )
    ''')

    # Criação do usuário Gerente padrão se não existir
    cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", ('gerente@restaurante.com',))
    if not cursor.fetchone():
        cursor.execute('''
            INSERT INTO users (name, email, password_hash, role, phone, address)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ''', (
            'Gerente do Restaurante',
            'gerente@restaurante.com',
            generate_password_hash('admin123'),
            'gerente',
            '(11) 98888-7777',
            'Restaurante Central'

    # Categorias padrão

    if cursor.fetchone()['count'] == 0:

init_db()

def current_user():
    user_id = session.get('user_id')
    if not user_id:
        return None
    conn = get_db()
    user = conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email, role, phone, address FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    return dict(user) if user else None

@app.route('/api/me')
def api_me():

@app.route('/api/register', methods=['POST'])
def api_register():
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    name = data.get('name', '').strip()
    email = data.get('email', '').strip().lower()
    password = data.get('password', '')
    phone = data.get('phone', '').strip()
    address = data.get('address', '').strip()

    if not name or not email or not password:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Nome, e-mail e senha são obrigatórios.'}), 400

    conn = get_db()
    existing = conn.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone()
    if existing:
        conn.close()
        return jsonify({'error': 'Este e-mail já está cadastrado.'}), 400

    hashed = generate_password_hash(password)
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('''
        INSERT INTO users (name, email, password_hash, role, phone, address)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'cliente', ?, ?)
    ''', (name, email, hashed, phone, address))
    user_id = cursor.lastrowid
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    session['user_id'] = user_id
    return jsonify({
        'success': True,
        'user': {
            'id': user_id,
            'name': name,
            'email': email,
            'role': 'cliente',
            'phone': phone,
            'address': address
        }
    })

@app.route('/api/login', methods=['POST'])
def api_login():
    data = request.get_json() or {}
    email = data.get('email', '').strip().lower()
    password = data.get('password', '')

    if not email or not password:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Preencha e-mail e senha.'}), 400

    conn = get_db()
    user = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()

    if not user or not check_password_hash(user['password_hash'], password):
        return jsonify({'error': 'E-mail ou senha incorretos.'}), 401

    session['user_id'] = user['id']
    return jsonify({
        'success': True,
        'user': {
            'id': user['id'],
            'name': user['name'],
            'email': user['email'],
            'role': user['role'],
            'phone': user['phone'],
            'address': user['address']
        }
    })

@app.route('/api/logout', methods=['POST'])
def api_logout():
    session.clear()
    return jsonify({'success': True})

# ==================== ROTAS DO CARDÁPIO ====================

@app.route('/api/menu')
def api_menu():
    conn = get_db()
    categories = [dict(c) for c in conn.execute("SELECT * FROM categories ORDER BY id ASC").fetchall()]
    
    # Gerente vê todos os itens (inclusive desativados), clientes veem apenas os disponíveis
    user = current_user()
    if user and user['role'] == 'gerente':
        dishes_raw = conn.execute('''
            SELECT d.*, c.name as category_name
            FROM dishes d
            JOIN categories c ON d.category_id = c.id
            ORDER BY d.category_id ASC, d.id ASC
        ''').fetchall()
    else:
        dishes_raw = conn.execute('''
            SELECT d.*, c.name as category_name
            FROM dishes d
            JOIN categories c ON d.category_id = c.id
            WHERE d.is_available = 1
            ORDER BY d.category_id ASC, d.id ASC
        ''').fetchall()

    dishes = [dict(d) for d in dishes_raw]
    conn.close()

    return jsonify({'categories': categories, 'dishes': dishes})

@app.route('/api/admin/dish', methods=['POST'])
def api_admin_add_dish():
    user = current_user()
    if not user or user['role'] != 'gerente':
        return jsonify({'error': 'Acesso negado.'}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    name = data.get('name', '').strip()
    category_id = data.get('category_id')
    price = data.get('price')
    description = data.get('description', '').strip()
    image_url = data.get('image_url', '').strip()
    is_available = 1 if data.get('is_available', True) else 0

    if not name or not category_id or price is None:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Nome, categoria e preço são obrigatórios.'}), 400

    try:
        price = float(price)
    except ValueError:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Preço inválido.'}), 400

    conn = get_db()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('''
        INSERT INTO dishes (category_id, name, description, price, image_url, is_available)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ''', (category_id, name, description, price, image_url, is_available))
    conn.commit()
    dish_id = cursor.lastrowid
    conn.close()

    return jsonify({'success': True, 'id': dish_id})

    return jsonify({'success': True})

@app.route('/api/admin/dish/<int:dish_id>', methods=['DELETE'])

    if not user or user['role'] != 'gerente':

    conn = get_db()
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM dishes WHERE id = ?", (dish_id,))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    return jsonify({'success': True})

@app.route('/api/orders', methods=['POST'])
def api_create_order():
    user = current_user()
    if not user:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Faça login para realizar um pedido.'}), 401

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    items = data.get('items', [])
    delivery_address = data.get('delivery_address', '').strip()
    customer_phone = data.get('customer_phone', '').strip()
    payment_method = data.get('payment_method', 'PIX').strip()
    notes = data.get('notes', '').strip()

    if not items:
        return jsonify({'error': 'O carrinho está vazio.'}), 400
    if not delivery_address:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Endereço de entrega é obrigatório.'}), 400
    if not customer_phone:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Telefone para contato é obrigatório.'}), 400

    conn = get_db()
    cursor = conn.cursor()

    # Calcular total e validar itens
    total_price = 0.0
    validated_items = []

    for item in items:
        dish_id = item.get('dish_id')
        qty = int(item.get('quantity', 1))
        if qty <= 0:
            continue
        
        dish = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM dishes WHERE id = ?", (dish_id,)).fetchone()
        if not dish:
            continue
        
        subtotal = round(dish['price'] * qty, 2)
        total_price += subtotal
        validated_items.append({
            'dish_id': dish['id'],
            'dish_name': dish['name'],
            'unit_price': dish['price'],
            'quantity': qty,
            'subtotal': subtotal,
            'notes': item.get('notes', '')
        })

    if not validated_items:
        conn.close()
        return jsonify({'error': 'Nenhum prato válido no carrinho.'}), 400

    total_price = round(total_price, 2)

    # Inserir pedido
    cursor.execute('''
        INSERT INTO orders (user_id, customer_name, customer_phone, delivery_address, payment_method, notes, total_price, status)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'recebido')
    ''', (user['id'], user['name'], customer_phone, delivery_address, payment_method, notes, total_price))
    order_id = cursor.lastrowid

    # Inserir itens
    for it in validated_items:
        cursor.execute('''
            INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, dish_id, dish_name, unit_price, quantity, subtotal, notes)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ''', (order_id, it['dish_id'], it['dish_name'], it['unit_price'], it['quantity'], it['subtotal'], it['notes']))

    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    return jsonify({'success': True, 'order_id': order_id})

@app.route('/api/my-orders')
def api_my_orders():
    user = current_user()
    if not user:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Não autenticado.'}), 401

    conn = get_db()
    orders_raw = conn.execute('''
        SELECT * FROM orders
        WHERE user_id = ?
        ORDER BY id DESC
    ''', (user['id'],)).fetchall()

    orders = []
    for o in orders_raw:
        o_dict = dict(o)
        items_raw = conn.execute('''
            SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id = ?
        ''', (o['id'],)).fetchall()
        o_dict['items'] = [dict(it) for it in items_raw]
        orders.append(o_dict)

    conn.close()
    return jsonify({'orders': orders})

@app.route('/api/admin/orders/<int:order_id>/status', methods=['PATCH'])
def api_admin_update_order_status(order_id):
    user = current_user()
    if not user or user['role'] != 'gerente':
        return jsonify({'error': 'Acesso negado.'}), 403

    data = request.get_json() or {}
    new_status = data.get('status', '').strip().lower()

    valid_statuses = ['recebido', 'preparando', 'saiu_entrega', 'entregue', 'cancelado']
    if new_status not in valid_statuses:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Status inválido.'}), 400

    conn = get_db()
    conn.execute("UPDATE orders SET status = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_status, order_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    return jsonify({'success': True, 'new_status': new_status})

      justify-content: space-between;

      font-size: 1.1rem;

    .order-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 14px;
      padding-top: 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);

    /* STEPPER DO CLIENTE */
    .tracker-steps {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      position: relative;
      margin: 16px 0 20px;
    }
    .tracker-steps::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px;
      left: 10%;
      right: 10%;
      height: 3px;
      background: var(--border);
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .tracker-step {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .step-circle {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #e0e0e0;
      color: #777;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;

      width: 48px;

    /* MENSAGEM VAZIA */

      text-align: center;

    /* TOAST NOTIFICAÇÃO */
    .toast {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 24px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);
      background: #263238;
      color: #fff;

    @media (max-width: 600px) {

      .brand span { display: none; }
      main { padding: 16px 12px 90px; }

    }
  </style>

          <div class="form-group" style="flex: 1;">
            <label>Preço (R$):</label>
            <input type="number" step="0.01" min="0" class="form-control" id="dish-price" required placeholder="29.90">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label>Descrição dos Ingredientes:</label>
          <textarea class="form-control" id="dish-desc" rows="3" placeholder="Pão, hambúrguer, queijo, salada..."></textarea>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label>Link da Foto (URL):</label>
          <input type="text" class="form-control" id="dish-image" placeholder="https://exemplo.com/foto.jpg">
        </div>
        <div class="form-group" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
          <input type="checkbox" id="dish-available" checked style="width: 18px; height: 18px;">
          <label for="dish-available" style="margin-bottom: 0; cursor: pointer;">Disponível no cardápio para pedidos</label>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-footer">
        <button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="closeDishModal()">Cancelar</button>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="saveDish()">Salvar Prato</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TOAST NOTIFICATION -->
  <div class="toast" id="toast">Aviso do sistema</div>

  <!-- ÁUDIO DE NOTIFICAÇÃO DE NOVO PEDIDO (Sintetizador Web Audio) -->

  <script>
    // ================= ESTADO GLOBAL =================
    let currentUser = null;
    let menuData = { categories: [], dishes: [] };
    let cart = [];
    let currentCategoryFilter = null;
    let currentAdminOrdersFilter = 'todos';
    let pollingInterval = null;
    let knownOrdersCount = 0;

    // ================= INICIALIZAÇÃO =================
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
      loadCartFromStorage();
      await checkAuth();
      await loadMenu();
      startPolling();
    });

    // ================= AUTENTICAÇÃO =================
    async function checkAuth() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/me');
        const data = await res.json();
        currentUser = data.user;
        updateUserUI();
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Erro ao verificar autenticação", e);
      }
    }

    function updateUserUI() {
      const navActions = document.getElementById('user-nav-actions');
      const tabMeusPedidos = document.getElementById('tab-btn-meus-pedidos');
      const tabGerentePedidos = document.getElementById('tab-btn-gerente-pedidos');
      const tabGerenteCardapio = document.getElementById('tab-btn-gerente-cardapio');
      const cartBtn = document.getElementById('cart-float-btn');

      if (currentUser) {
        if (currentUser.role === 'gerente') {
          tabMeusPedidos.style.display = 'none';
          tabGerentePedidos.style.display = 'flex';
          tabGerenteCardapio.style.display = 'flex';
          cartBtn.style.display = 'none';

          navActions.innerHTML = `
            <span style="font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; background: var(--primary-light); color: var(--primary); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 20px;">
              ⭐ Gerente (${escapeHtml(currentUser.name)})
            </span>
            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="handleLogout()">Sair</button>
          `;
        } else {
          tabMeusPedidos.style.display = 'flex';
          tabGerentePedidos.style.display = 'none';
          tabGerenteCardapio.style.display = 'none';
          cartBtn.style.display = 'flex';

          navActions.innerHTML = `
            <span style="font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600;">Olá, ${escapeHtml(currentUser.name.split(' ')[0])}</span>
            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="handleLogout()">Sair</button>
          `;
        }
      } else {
        tabMeusPedidos.style.display = 'none';
        tabGerentePedidos.style.display = 'none';
        tabGerenteCardapio.style.display = 'none';
        cartBtn.style.display = 'flex';

        navActions.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn btn-outline" onclick="openAuthModal('login')">Entrar</button>
          <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openAuthModal('register')">Criar Conta</button>
        `;
      }
    }

    async function handleLogin(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const email = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
      const password = document.getElementById('login-password').value;

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (res.ok) {
          currentUser = data.user;
          updateUserUI();
          closeAuthModal();
          showToast(`Bem-vindo de volta, ${currentUser.name}!`);
          if (currentUser.role === 'gerente') {
            switchView('gerente-pedidos');
          } else {
            loadMenu();
          }
        } else {
          showToast(data.error || 'Erro ao entrar.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Erro de conexão ao fazer login.');
      }
    }

    async function handleRegister(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const name = document.getElementById('reg-name').value;
      const email = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
      const password = document.getElementById('reg-password').value;
      const phone = document.getElementById('reg-phone').value;
      const address = document.getElementById('reg-address').value;

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/register', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ name, email, password, phone, address })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (res.ok) {
          currentUser = data.user;
          updateUserUI();
          closeAuthModal();
          showToast(`Conta criada com sucesso! Olá, ${currentUser.name}.`);
          loadMenu();
        } else {
          showToast(data.error || 'Erro ao criar conta.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Erro de conexão ao criar conta.');
      }
    }

    async function handleLogout() {
      await fetch('/api/logout', { method: 'POST' });
      currentUser = null;
      updateUserUI();
      switchView('cardapio');
      showToast('Você saiu da sua conta.');
      loadMenu();
    }

    // ================= CARDÁPIO =================
    async function loadMenu() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/menu');
        menuData = await res.json();
        renderCategories();
        renderDishes();
        renderAdminCategorySelect();
        if (currentUser && currentUser.role === 'gerente') {
          renderAdminMenuTable();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Erro ao carregar cardápio", e);
      }
    }

    function renderCategories() {
      const container = document.getElementById('category-pills');
      container.innerHTML = `<button class="pill ${currentCategoryFilter === null ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="filterCategory(null)">Todos</button>`;
      menuData.categories.forEach(cat => {
        const active = currentCategoryFilter === cat.id ? 'active' : '';
        container.innerHTML += `<button class="pill ${active}" onclick="filterCategory(${cat.id})">${escapeHtml(cat.name)}</button>`;
      });
    }

    function filterCategory(catId) {
      currentCategoryFilter = catId;
      renderCategories();
      renderDishes();
    }

    function filterDishes() {
      renderDishes();
    }

    function renderDishes() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('dishes-grid');
      const search = document.getElementById('search-input').value.toLowerCase().trim();

      let filtered = menuData.dishes;

      if (currentCategoryFilter !== null) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(d => d.category_id === currentCategoryFilter);
      }

      if (search) {
        filtered = filtered.filter(d => 
          d.name.toLowerCase().includes(search) || 
          (d.description && d.description.toLowerCase().includes(search))
        );
      }

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        grid.innerHTML = `
          <div class="empty-state" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
            <div class="empty-state-icon">🍽️</div>
            <h3>Nenhum prato encontrado</h3>
            <p>Tente buscar por outro termo ou categoria.</p>
          </div>
        `;
        return;
      }

      grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(dish => {
        const fallbackImg = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1546069901-ba9599a7e63c?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop';
        const img = dish.image_url ? dish.image_url : fallbackImg;
        return `
          <div class="dish-card">
            <div class="dish-img-wrapper">
              <img src="${escapeHtml(img)}" alt="${escapeHtml(dish.name)}" class="dish-img" onerror="this.src='${fallbackImg}'">
              <div class="dish-badge">${escapeHtml(dish.category_name)}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="dish-body">
              <h3 class="dish-title">${escapeHtml(dish.name)}</h3>
              <p class="dish-desc">${escapeHtml(dish.description || 'Deliciosa opção preparada com ingredientes selecionados.')}</p>
              <div class="dish-footer">
                <span class="dish-price">R$ ${dish.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</span>
                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="addToCart(${dish.id})">
                  + Adicionar
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    // ================= CARRINHO =================
    function loadCartFromStorage() {
      try {
        const stored = localStorage.getItem('restaurante_carrinho');
        if (stored) cart = JSON.parse(stored);
      } catch (e) { cart = []; }
      updateCartBadge();
    }

    function saveCartToStorage() {
      localStorage.setItem('restaurante_carrinho', JSON.stringify(cart));
      updateCartBadge();
    }

    function addToCart(dishId) {
      const dish = menuData.dishes.find(d => d.id === dishId);
      if (!dish) return;

      const existing = cart.find(item => item.dish_id === dishId);
      if (existing) {
        existing.quantity += 1;
      } else {
        cart.push({
          dish_id: dish.id,
          name: dish.name,
          price: dish.price,
          quantity: 1,
          notes: ''
        });
      }

      saveCartToStorage();
      showToast(`"${dish.name}" adicionado ao carrinho!`);
    }

    function updateCartBadge() {
      const totalQty = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
      document.getElementById('cart-badge').innerText = totalQty;
    }

    function openCartModal() {
      renderCartItems();
      if (currentUser) {
        if (currentUser.phone) document.getElementById('order-phone').value = currentUser.phone;
        if (currentUser.address) document.getElementById('order-address').value = currentUser.address;
      }
      document.getElementById('modal-cart').classList.add('open');
    }

    function closeCartModal() {
      document.getElementById('modal-cart').classList.remove('open');
    }

    function renderCartItems() {
      const container = document.getElementById('cart-items-container');
      const checkoutSection = document.getElementById('cart-checkout-section');
      const totalSpan = document.getElementById('cart-total-price');

      if (cart.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
          <div class="empty-state">
            <div class="empty-state-icon">🛒</div>
            <h4>Seu carrinho está vazio</h4>
            <p>Escolha seus pratos favoritos no cardápio.</p>
          </div>
        `;
        checkoutSection.style.display = 'none';
        totalSpan.innerText = 'R$ 0,00';
        return;
      }

      checkoutSection.style.display = 'block';
      let total = 0;

      container.innerHTML = cart.map((item, index) => {
        const subtotal = item.price * item.quantity;
        total += subtotal;
        return `
          <div class="cart-item">
            <div class="cart-item-info">
              <div class="cart-item-name">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</div>
              <div class="cart-item-price">R$ ${item.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} cada</div>
              <input type="text" class="form-control" style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 0.8rem; margin-top: 4px;" 
                placeholder="Observação (ex: sem cebola)" 
                value="${escapeHtml(item.notes || '')}" 
                onchange="updateCartNotes(${index}, this.value)">
            </div>
            <div class="qty-controls">
              <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeCartQty(${index}, -1)">-</button>
              <span style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; min-width: 20px; text-align: center;">${item.quantity}</span>
              <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeCartQty(${index}, 1)">+</button>
            </div>
            <div style="font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; min-width: 70px; text-align: right;">
              R$ ${subtotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
      }).join('');

      totalSpan.innerText = `R$ ${total.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`;
    }

    function changeCartQty(index, delta) {
      if (!cart[index]) return;
      cart[index].quantity += delta;
      if (cart[index].quantity <= 0) {
        cart.splice(index, 1);
      }
      saveCartToStorage();
      renderCartItems();
    }

    function updateCartNotes(index, val) {
      if (cart[index]) {
        cart[index].notes = val.trim();
        saveCartToStorage();
      }
    }

    async function submitOrder() {
      if (!currentUser) {
        closeCartModal();
        openAuthModal('login');
        showToast('Faça login ou cadastre-se para fechar o pedido.');
        return;
      }

      const phone = document.getElementById('order-phone').value.trim();
      const address = document.getElementById('order-address').value.trim();
      const payment = document.getElementById('order-payment').value;
      const notes = document.getElementById('order-notes').value.trim();

      if (!phone) {
        alert('Por favor, informe um telefone para contato.');
        return;
      }
      if (!address) {
        alert('Por favor, informe o endereço de entrega.');
        return;
      }

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/orders', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            items: cart,
            customer_phone: phone,
            delivery_address: address,
            payment_method: payment,
            notes: notes
          })
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        if (res.ok) {
          cart = [];
          saveCartToStorage();
          closeCartModal();
          showToast('🎉 Pedido realizado com sucesso!');
          switchView('meus-pedidos');
          loadClientOrders();
        } else {
          alert(data.error || 'Erro ao processar pedido.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        alert('Erro de conexão ao enviar o pedido.');
      }
    }

    // ================= ACOMPANHAMENTO DE PEDIDOS (CLIENTE) =================
    async function loadClientOrders() {
      if (!currentUser) return;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/my-orders');
        const data = await res.json();
        const list = document.getElementById('client-orders-list');

        if (!data.orders || data.orders.length === 0) {
          list.innerHTML = `
            <div class="empty-state">
              <div class="empty-state-icon">📦</div>
              <h3>Você ainda não fez nenhum pedido</h3>
              <p>Volte ao cardápio e faça seu primeiro pedido agora!</p>
              <button class="btn btn-primary" style="margin-top: 14px;" onclick="switchView('cardapio')">Ver Cardápio</button>
            </div>
          `;
          return;
        }

        list.innerHTML = data.orders.map(order => renderOrderCard(order, false)).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Erro ao buscar meus pedidos", e);
      }
    }

    function renderOrderCard(order, isAdmin = false) {
      const statusMap = {
        'recebido': { label: 'Recebido', class: 'status-recebido', step: 1 },
        'preparando': { label: 'Em Preparo', class: 'status-preparando', step: 2 },
        'saiu_entrega': { label: 'Saiu para Entrega', class: 'status-saiu_entrega', step: 3 },
        'entregue': { label: 'Entregue', class: 'status-entregue', step: 4 },
        'cancelado': { label: 'Cancelado', class: 'status-cancelado', step: 0 }
      };

      const curr = statusMap[order.status] || { label: order.status, class: '', step: 1 };

      // Se for cliente e pedido não estiver cancelado, mostra a linha do tempo (stepper)
      let trackerHtml = '';
      if (!isAdmin && order.status !== 'cancelado') {
        const steps = [
          { num: 1, name: 'Recebido' },
          { num: 2, name: 'Na Cozinha' },
          { num: 3, name: 'A Caminho' },
          { num: 4, name: 'Entregue' }
        ];
        trackerHtml = `
          <div class="tracker-steps">
            ${steps.map(s => {
              const stateClass = s.num < curr.step ? 'completed' : (s.num === curr.step ? 'active' : '');
              return `
                <div class="tracker-step ${stateClass}">
                  <div class="step-circle">${s.num < curr.step ? '✓' : s.num}</div>
                  <div class="step-text">${s.name}</div>
                </div>
              `;
            }).join('')}
          </div>
        `;
      }

      const itemsRows = order.items.map(it => `
        <tr>
          <td><strong>${it.quantity}x</strong> ${escapeHtml(it.dish_name)} ${it.notes ? `<span class="cart-item-notes">(${escapeHtml(it.notes)})</span>` : ''}</td>
          <td style="text-align: right;">R$ ${it.subtotal.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</td>
        </tr>
      `).join('');

      let adminActionsHtml = '';
      if (isAdmin) {
        adminActionsHtml = `
          <div class="order-actions">
            <span style="font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-muted); align-self: center; margin-right: 6px;">Mudar Status:</span>
            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="updateOrderStatus(${order.id}, 'recebido')">Recebido</button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" style="color: var(--info); border-color: var(--info);" onclick="updateOrderStatus(${order.id}, 'preparando')">👨‍🍳 Em Preparo</button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" style="color: #7b1fa2; border-color: #7b1fa2;" onclick="updateOrderStatus(${order.id}, 'saiu_entrega')">🛵 Saiu p/ Entrega</button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" style="color: var(--success); border-color: var(--success);" onclick="updateOrderStatus(${order.id}, 'entregue')">✅ Entregue</button>
            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" style="color: var(--danger); border-color: var(--danger);" onclick="updateOrderStatus(${order.id}, 'cancelado')">❌ Cancelar</button>
          </div>
        `;
      }

      return `
        <div class="order-card">
          <div class="order-card-header">
            <div>
              <span class="order-id">Pedido #${order.id}</span>
              <div class="order-date">📅 ${new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</div>
            </div>
            <span class="status-badge ${curr.class}">${curr.label}</span>
          </div>

          ${trackerHtml}

          <div class="order-customer-box">
            <strong>Cliente:</strong> ${escapeHtml(order.customer_name)} | <strong>Tel:</strong> ${escapeHtml(order.customer_phone)}<br>
            <strong>Endereço de Entrega:</strong> ${escapeHtml(order.delivery_address)}<br>
            <strong>Pagamento:</strong> ${escapeHtml(order.payment_method)}
            ${order.notes ? `<br><strong>Obs do Cliente:</strong> <em>${escapeHtml(order.notes)}</em>` : ''}
          </div>

          <table class="order-items-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Item</th>
                <th style="text-align: right;">Subtotal</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              ${itemsRows}
            </tbody>
          </table>

          <div class="order-total-bar">
            <span>Total Pago</span>
            <span style="color: var(--primary);">R$ ${order.total_price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</span>
          </div>

          ${adminActionsHtml}
        </div>
      `;
    }

    // ================= PAINEL DO GERENTE =================
    async function loadAdminOrders() {
      if (!currentUser || currentUser.role !== 'gerente') return;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/orders');
        const data = await res.json();
        const list = document.getElementById('admin-orders-list');

        let orders = data.orders || [];

        // Tocar alerta sonoro se novo pedido chegou
        if (orders.length > knownOrdersCount && knownOrdersCount !== 0) {
          playNotificationBeep();
          showToast('🔔 Novo pedido recebido!');
        }
        knownOrdersCount = orders.length;

        if (currentAdminOrdersFilter !== 'todos') {
          orders = orders.filter(o => o.status === currentAdminOrdersFilter);
        }

        if (orders.length === 0) {
          list.innerHTML = `
            <div class="empty-state">
              <div class="empty-state-icon">📋</div>
              <h3>Nenhum pedido nesta situação</h3>
              <p>Os pedidos dos clientes aparecerão aqui automaticamente.</p>
            </div>
          `;
          return;
        }

        list.innerHTML = orders.map(order => renderOrderCard(order, true)).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Erro ao carregar pedidos administrativos", e);
      }
    }

    function filterAdminOrders(status) {
      currentAdminOrdersFilter = status;
      const pills = document.querySelectorAll('#view-gerente-pedidos .category-pills .pill');
      pills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      event.target.classList.add('active');
      loadAdminOrders();
    }

    async function updateOrderStatus(orderId, newStatus) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/orders/${orderId}/status`, {
          method: 'PATCH',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ status: newStatus })
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          showToast(`Pedido #${orderId} alterado para ${newStatus}.`);
          loadAdminOrders();
        } else {
          showToast('Erro ao atualizar status.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Erro de conexão ao atualizar status.');
      }
    }

    // ================= GERENCIAMENTO DO CARDÁPIO (GERENTE) =================
    function renderAdminMenuTable() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('admin-menu-tbody');
      tbody.innerHTML = menuData.dishes.map(dish => {
        const fallbackImg = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1546069901-ba9599a7e63c?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop';
        return `
          <tr>
            <td>
              <img src="${escapeHtml(dish.image_url || fallbackImg)}" class="dish-thumb" onerror="this.src='${fallbackImg}'">
            </td>
            <td>
              <strong>${escapeHtml(dish.name)}</strong><br>
              <small style="color: var(--text-muted);">${escapeHtml(dish.description || 'Sem descrição')}</small>
            </td>
            <td>${escapeHtml(dish.category_name)}</td>
            <td><strong>R$ ${dish.price.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}</strong></td>
            <td>
              ${dish.is_available 
                ? '<span style="color: var(--success); font-weight:700;">● Disponível</span>' 
                : '<span style="color: var(--danger); font-weight:700;">○ Indisponível</span>'}
            </td>
            <td>
              <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="editDishModal(${dish.id})">✏️ Editar</button>
              <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" style="color: var(--danger);" onclick="deleteDish(${dish.id})">🗑️</button>
            </td>
          </tr>
        `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function renderAdminCategorySelect() {
      const sel = document.getElementById('dish-category');
      sel.innerHTML = menuData.categories.map(c => `
        <option value="${c.id}">${escapeHtml(c.name)}</option>
      `).join('');
    }

    function openDishModal() {
      document.getElementById('dish-modal-title').innerText = 'Novo Prato';
      document.getElementById('dish-id').value = '';
      document.getElementById('dish-name').value = '';
      document.getElementById('dish-price').value = '';
      document.getElementById('dish-desc').value = '';
      document.getElementById('dish-image').value = '';
      document.getElementById('dish-available').checked = true;
      document.getElementById('modal-dish').classList.add('open');
    }

    function editDishModal(dishId) {
      const dish = menuData.dishes.find(d => d.id === dishId);
      if (!dish) return;

      document.getElementById('dish-modal-title').innerText = 'Editar Prato';
      document.getElementById('dish-id').value = dish.id;
      document.getElementById('dish-name').value = dish.name;
      document.getElementById('dish-category').value = dish.category_id;
      document.getElementById('dish-price').value = dish.price;
      document.getElementById('dish-desc').value = dish.description || '';
      document.getElementById('dish-image').value = dish.image_url || '';
      document.getElementById('dish-available').checked = !!dish.is_available;
      document.getElementById('modal-dish').classList.add('open');
    }

    function closeDishModal() {
      document.getElementById('modal-dish').classList.remove('open');
    }

    async function saveDish() {
      const id = document.getElementById('dish-id').value;
      const name = document.getElementById('dish-name').value.trim();
      const category_id = parseInt(document.getElementById('dish-category').value);
      const price = parseFloat(document.getElementById('dish-price').value);
      const description = document.getElementById('dish-desc').value.trim();
      const image_url = document.getElementById('dish-image').value.trim();
      const is_available = document.getElementById('dish-available').checked;

      if (!name || isNaN(price)) {
        alert('Preencha pelo menos o Nome e o Preço do prato.');
        return;
      }

      const payload = { name, category_id, price, description, image_url, is_available };

      try {
        let res;
        if (id) {
          res = await fetch(`/api/admin/dish/${id}`, {
            method: 'PUT',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
          });
        } else {
          res = await fetch('/api/admin/dish', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify(payload)
          });
        }

        if (res.ok) {
          closeDishModal();
          showToast(id ? 'Prato atualizado!' : 'Prato cadastrado com sucesso!');
          await loadMenu();
        } else {
          const err = await res.json();
          alert(err.error || 'Erro ao salvar prato.');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        alert('Erro ao conectar ao servidor.');
      }
    }

    async function deleteDish(dishId) {
      if (!confirm('Deseja realmente excluir este prato do cardápio?')) return;
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/dish/${dishId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
        if (res.ok) {
          showToast('Prato removido.');
          await loadMenu();
        }
      } catch (err) {
        showToast('Erro ao excluir prato.');
      }
    }

      const views = ['cardapio', 'meus-pedidos', 'gerente-pedidos', 'gerente-cardapio'];
      views.forEach(v => {
        const el = document.getElementById(`view-${v}`);
        const tabBtn = document.getElementById(`tab-btn-${v}`);
        if (el) el.style.display = (v === viewName) ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (tabBtn) tabBtn.classList.toggle('active', v === viewName);
      });

      if (viewName === 'meus-pedidos') loadClientOrders();
      if (viewName === 'gerente-pedidos') loadAdminOrders();
      if (viewName === 'gerente-cardapio') renderAdminMenuTable();
    }

    // ================= MODAIS DE LOGIN / CADASTRO =================
    function openAuthModal(mode = 'login') {
      toggleAuthForm(mode);
      document.getElementById('modal-auth').classList.add('open');
    }

    function closeAuthModal() {
      document.getElementById('modal-auth').classList.remove('open');
    }

    function toggleAuthForm(mode) {
      const formLogin = document.getElementById('form-login');
      const formRegister = document.getElementById('form-register');
      const title = document.getElementById('auth-modal-title');

      if (mode === 'register') {
        formLogin.style.display = 'none';
        formRegister.style.display = 'block';
        title.innerText = 'Criar Nova Conta';
      } else {
        formLogin.style.display = 'block';
        formRegister.style.display = 'none';
        title.innerText = 'Entrar na sua Conta';
      }
    }

    function startPolling() {
      // Atualiza pedidos e cardápio a cada 6 segundos sem recarregar a tela
      pollingInterval = setInterval(() => {
        if (currentUser) {
          if (currentUser.role === 'gerente') {
            const isVisible = document.getElementById('view-gerente-pedidos').style.display !== 'none';
            if (isVisible) loadAdminOrders();
          } else {
            const isVisible = document.getElementById('view-meus-pedidos').style.display !== 'none';
            if (isVisible) loadClientOrders();
          }
        }
      }, 6000);
    }

    // ================= UTILITÁRIOS =================
    function showToast(msg) {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      toast.innerText = msg;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
      if (!text) return '';
      return String(text)
        .replace(/&/g, "&")
        .replace(/</g, "<")
        .replace(/>/g, ">")
        .replace(/"/g, """)
        .replace(/'/g, "'");
    }

    function playNotificationBeep() {
      try {
        const ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = ctx.createGain();
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(ctx.destination);
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(587.33, ctx.currentTime); // D5
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(880, ctx.currentTime + 0.15); // A5
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.4);
        osc.start();
        osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.4);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  </script>
</body>
